policy.numeric_if: All consequential equation inputs are attributable to source or measurement and the model/regime is valid.
policy.symbolic: Keep the equation symbolic when one or more consequential inputs are unresolved.
policy.hold: HOLD when model validity, directional process compatibility, prior-layer damage, safety/authority or evidence is unresolved.

invariants.name: parallel-plate capacitance density
invariants.boundary: parallel-plate field assumptions only; fringe/interface/loss/leakage/defects separate

invariants.name: sheet path resistance
invariants.boundary: cured/process-specific sheet resistance and contacts required

invariants.name: resistor geometry factor
invariants.boundary: target is geometry factor only; witness Rs/TCR/adhesion required

invariants.name: RL electrical time constant
invariants.boundary: winding electrical baseline only; not torque-speed response

invariants.name: Joule winding baseline
invariants.boundary: electrical copper-loss baseline; driver regulation/duty/thermal model separate

invariants.name: axis required force
invariants.boundary: target envelope must be declared; no machine capability inferred

invariants.name: belt force mapping
invariants.boundary: requires torque-speed point, transmission geometry and efficiency

invariants.name: screw force mapping
invariants.boundary: requires torque-speed point, screw efficiency/critical-speed/load checks

invariants.name: independent uncertainty RSS
invariants.boundary: use covariance/nonlinear propagation when independence/linearity is invalid

invariants.name: circular-feed retention ratio
invariants.boundary: application-specific comparator; no universal acceptance threshold

smart_stack_reference.sequence_rule: Order by directional X→Y compatibility, required environment, interface/interlayer and preservation envelope; insert/test inaccessible buried features before closure.

comparator_metrics: yield ratio under the same frozen process
resistivity/insulation ratio only when dielectric use is proposed
circular_reference.acceptance: declared application envelope + uncertainty; no universal pass percentage
